lines.en: The grass under my feet has withered.

lines.zh: 这条路我飘过，那时还有腿。
lines.en: I drifted this path when I still had legs.

lines.zh: 我的影子滑过，连声音都被吞了。
lines.en: My shadow slips past, and even sound is swallowed.
The moon moves; I drift along.
I float without even a shadow.

lines.zh: 我没有腿，只有一身幽匿。
lines.en: I have no legs, only sculk.
Don't rush. Floating is as fast as I get.

lines.zh: 我这副骨身飘着，比走快。
lines.en: This bone body drifts faster than it walks.
One block, another, drifting down.
Ten points of armor on sculk hide.

lines.zh: 我飘过的地方，菌丝留下。
lines.en: Where I drift, mycelium remains.

lines.zh: 咔哒，深绿的音乐在身后。
lines.en: Clack, the dark green music is behind me.

lines.zh: 风停了，我挂在半空不动。
lines.en: The wind stopped, and I hang motionless.

lines.zh: 数肋骨，数到第七根就乱了。
lines.en: Counting ribs; I lose track at the seventh.
No need to breathe. Only to wail.
So quiet I hear my tendrils drip.

lines.zh: 天亮也无妨，我飘在树荫下。
lines.en: Dawn's fine. I drift in the shade.

lines.zh: 我的泪，落到地上变成幽匿。
lines.en: My tears become sculk where they land.

lines.zh: 忘了件要紧事，像是名字。
lines.en: I forgot something important. My name, maybe.

lines.zh: 飘到天荒地老，也掉不下来。
lines.en: I could drift till the world ends, never falling.

lines.zh: 活着时我坐在这，现在只能飘。
lines.en: Alive I sat here. Now I only float.

lines.zh: 谁点的灯，照得我睁不开眼。
lines.en: Who lit that lamp? It blinds me.

lines.zh: 你背后那棵树，长了幽匿。
lines.en: Sculk has grown up the tree behind you.
Your scent hangs in the air.

lines.zh: 你的眼睛，能不能借我挂着。
lines.en: Your eyes. Could I hang them up?

lines.zh: 你的影子投在菌毯上，真长。
lines.en: Your shadow on the sculk mat is so long.
Not hungry. I'm only smelling you.
My wail carries a long way.

lines.zh: 我飘着，十层甲裹着身子。
lines.en: I float, wrapped in ten layers of armor.

lines.zh: 名字记不住，脸我记住了。
lines.en: I can't hold your name, but I have your face.
We met a long time ago.

lines.zh: 别怕，我只用一只眼瞧你。
lines.en: Don't fear. I look with only one eye.

lines.zh: 活着时从没摔过这么重。
lines.en: Alive, I never fell this hard.

lines.zh: 听见没，我的骨头在漏风。
lines.en: Hear that? Air leaks through my bones.
Not scattered yet. Ten armor still hangs on.

lines.zh: 百点血，也经不起你连打。
lines.en: A hundred health, and your combo still wears it down.
My tears come down as spores.
Stay back — my hide is seeping.

lines.zh: 停手，我的触须缠上你了。
lines.en: Stop. My tendrils have found you.

lines.zh: 这身皮囊，经不起第二下。
lines.en: This borrowed body will not take another hit.

lines.zh: 我这几条触须，已经伸向你。
lines.en: These tendrils already reach for you.
Wrapped in sculk, and pain is still pain.

lines.zh: 活物的味，浓得我飘不稳。
lines.en: The living smell is so thick I wobble.
Put it down. I'll tear off just a little.

lines.zh: 我这条触须，吸得动幽匿。
lines.en: My tendrils can draw sculk.
Don't take it. Let me smell it once more.
Just one bite. I won't wail.
Hunger is a pit without a bottom.
I shouldn't want this.

lines.zh: 没有手指，触须却往前伸。
lines.en: No fingers, yet my tendrils reach out.

lines.zh: 饿这字，我哭了很久才记住。
lines.en: I wept a long time before learning hungry.
I smell blood. Don't say where.

lines.zh: 我身上的泪痕，是幽匿的。
lines.en: The streaks on me are sculk.

lines.zh: 对不起。这句话我说不利索。
lines.en: Sorry. I can't say that cleanly.

lines.zh: 站稳，你踩到我的触须了。
lines.en: Steady. You're standing on my tendrils.
Watch where you walk; hitting me is unwise.
Ten armor, and the bump still hurts.

lines.zh: 谁撞的，我飘着也能被撞歪。
lines.en: Who bumped me? Even drifting, I get knocked askew.

lines.zh: 十点护甲，压得我飞不高。
lines.en: Ten points of armor weigh my flight down.

lines.zh: 我在菌毯上挪一步，孢子往你脚边散。
lines.en: I shift one step on the sculk and spores drift to your feet.
Back off. My tendrils tangle.

lines.zh: 走开，你碰掉的都是幽匿。
lines.en: Move. What you knock off me is sculk.
Next life, I'll drift over earlier.

lines.zh: 我们挂在树荫下，谁也够不着。
lines.en: We hang in the shade, out of reach.
My tendrils hang to the ground.

lines.zh: 别说爱，说你还记得我飘着。
lines.en: Don't say love. Say you remember me floating.
Don't look. Half my face is gone.
My heart stopped long ago, and still aches.
My fingers are sculk blocks now.

lines.zh: 戒指会从触须上滑下去。
lines.en: The ring slides right off my tendrils.
I float overhead, waiting for you to look up.

lines.zh: 永恒就是一直飘，不着地。
lines.en: Forever means drifting, never landing.
Left on the ground — is it for me?
I had one of these, before.

lines.zh: 先挂在触须上，也许用得上。
lines.en: Hang it on a tendril in case it's useful.
Turned up from under the sculk mat.
Even drifting, I know this thing.
From up here I see all the sculk.
Hold it. Drop it and it's buried in sculk.
Bright things I hang up in the sky.

lines.zh: 幽匿的味道，像用过的东西。
lines.en: Sculk smells like something used.
This gets buried in the sculk.
This is no road for the living.
Your heart's so loud — you can't hide.
When I open my mouth, it's a cloud of spores.
Whoever moves first loses their life.
You — the scent doesn't lie.

lines.zh: 幽匿的泪飘下来，生者站住。
lines.en: Sculk tears drift down — living one, halt.

lines.zh: 十点护甲，火球也穿不透。
lines.en: Ten armor; fireballs won't get through.
Don't move. I'm aimed right at you.
I drift over lava lakes, steadier than you.

lines.zh: 那双眼睛，我要挂在触须上。
lines.en: Those eyes go on my tendrils.
Found you, right above your head.
Confirmed. You're directly below me.

lines.zh: 你身上的味，飘上来很新鲜。
lines.en: Your scent rises fresh.

lines.zh: 幽匿把我抬起来，飘过墙。
lines.en: Sculk lifts me and I float over the wall.

lines.zh: 别回头，火球已经出来了。
lines.en: Don't turn. The fireball's already out.

lines.zh: 我的触须垂到地面，替你止步。
lines.en: My tendrils hang to the ground to stop you.

lines.zh: 绕了一圈，终于飘到你上方。
lines.en: A long loop, and I finally drift above you.
My fireballs are green.
I don't pant. I only wail above.
I don't need to land, or breathe.

lines.zh: 你的影子短短的，我的长得远。
lines.en: Your shadow's short; mine stretches far.
Stop. I'll drift down and talk.
Floating never tires. Never.

lines.zh: 幽匿的网，把这条道封了。
lines.en: Sculk webbing has sealed this path.

lines.zh: 你抬头看看，我已经到了。
lines.en: Look up. I'm already here.
Pant. I'll wait up here.

lines.zh: 幽匿的丝把我吊在半空。
lines.en: Sculk threads hold me midair.
I won't go near that bright patch.

lines.zh: 我在天空里挂着，等你抬头。
lines.en: I hang in the sky; look up.
I drift slowly, but my wail carries.
Wait for me. I drift slowly.
Run slow. Don't step in a sculk pit.

lines.zh: 这片菌毯，我从上看惯了。
lines.en: I know this sculk mat from above.
Slow down. I don't drift fast.

lines.zh: 十点护甲，裹着这团幽匿。
lines.en: Ten armor wrapped around this sculk.
The more you run, the tighter the fireballs follow.
No legs, and I still catch you.
Move. I'm drifting through.
Ten points of armor, I float slowly.
Six points of force is enough to knock you down.
Don't dodge. I drift slow and can't catch you.
Again. I haven't drifted enough.

lines.zh: 我这一巴掌，够你退三步。
lines.en: This swat will put you back three steps.
Listen. Bone striking sculk.
One step back, and I drift closer.
Bone slaps down with a dull thud.
Don't cry out. Wailing is mine.

lines.zh: 这团幽匿，只剩撞人的用处。
lines.en: This lump of sculk is only good for hitting.
Fall. Floating tires me none.
Drifted wide. Missed.
Can't pull the tendrils back from this swing.
See? A hundred health can still swing.
Take it. That's my tendril.

lines.zh: 活人退后，我刚从菌里浮起。
lines.en: Stand back. I've just risen from the sculk.
From the sculk, I have returned.
Sculk mat underfoot, softer than soil.
Dark? Perfect. Time to drift out.

lines.zh: 我从菌丝里飘起来，很轻。
lines.en: I float up out of the mycelium, weightless.

lines.zh: 我从幽匿里浮上来，很轻。
lines.en: I float up out of the sculk, weightless.

lines.zh: 我飘过的地方，都长了幽匿。
lines.en: Where I drift, sculk grows.
How long did I sleep?
Too bright. My eye is shrinking.

lines.zh: 又是这团没有腿的身子。
lines.en: This legless body again.

lines.zh: 十点护甲的皮，裹着冷风。
lines.en: Ten armor of hide wrapped around cold air.

lines.zh: 没有腿，只能慢慢飘起来。
lines.en: No legs. I can only float up slowly.

lines.zh: 幽匿填满我的胸腔，我起来了。
lines.en: Sculk fills my chest and I rise.
Sculk tendrils hang in the sky.

lines.zh: 火一烧，我身上的幽匿就焦了。
lines.en: Fire scorches the sculk all over me.
Drifting that high, the ground hits hard.
A sculk body does not float.

lines.zh: 我身上的皮，被炸开一块。
lines.en: A blast tore a patch off my hide.

lines.zh: 谁在暗处放箭，扎我触须。
lines.en: Who shoots from the dark, into my tendrils?
Magic crawls up my tendrils.
Too hungry to float. I'm sinking.

lines.zh: 天在打我，雷也感染不了。
lines.en: The sky strikes me; lightning cannot infect.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有幽匿，我会饿。
lines.en: No sculk in the void; I would starve.
